title: Birdwatching in Tanzania for Beginners
excerpt: Tanzania has more than 1,000 bird species. Birdwatching tips for beginners and the best parks for birds.
body:
## Rich in birds

Tanzania has recorded over a thousand bird species, including endemics.

## Best parks

- Tarangire.
- Lake Manyara.
- Arusha National Park.
- Nyerere and Ruaha.
- Udzungwa and the Usambaras for forest birds.

## When

November to April, when migratory birds arrive.

## Gear

- Binoculars.
- A field guide or app.
- A camera with zoom.

## Tips

- Start early.
- Listen as well as look.
- Ask your guide.

See [colourful birds](/blog/lilac-breasted-roller/) or [plan your trip](/travel-proposal/).
